description: Find your five Karvonen heart-rate training zones from your age and resting heart rate, with BPM ranges.

faqs.a: Each zone is a percentage band of your heart-rate reserve (max HR minus resting HR) added back to your resting HR: zone HR = resting + reserve × %. It personalizes zones better than raw % of max HR.
Max heart rate is estimated as 220 − age. It is a rough population average — individual max can differ by 10–20 bpm, so treat zones as guidance, not precision.
Stop, rest, and seek medical advice if you feel dizzy, chest pain or unusual shortness of breath. This tool is for general fitness guidance only.
faqs.q: Is it safe to train in zone 5?

howto: Enter your resting heart rate in BPM (measure it first thing in the morning).
Read your estimated max heart rate.
Use the five zone table to target the right intensity for each workout.
title: Heart Rate Zone Calculator
